transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: It's Dana at the main checkpoint. We are trying to verify boarding passes, but the scanners are rejecting everyone because the flight data doesn't match the bar codes.

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: The line is backing up past the atrium. People are getting crushed. [shouting in background]

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: We are going to stop screening completely until you fix the data. I'm not putting my officers in that crowd. I need someone from your side down here now.

voiceStyles.TSA: Woman in her 40s, stressed and loud over crowd noise at a security checkpoint
